<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Sales_Order" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Sales_Order">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Potential customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Sales and customer support" processRef="Process_Sales_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales_Order" name="Sales and order process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Inquiry" messageRef="Msg_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant customer information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested_Split" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested, inquiry closed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproved" name="Quote approved by customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_QuoteApproved" messageRef="Msg_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order successfully placed and confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interested_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
